b.x: If the wish is to die, or if you have already hurt yourself: in Brazil, dial 188 now. CVV answers for free, 24 hours. If there is already a wound, too much medicine, or no breath, 192. Outside Brazil, the number is different: the crisis line of the country you are in, or the local medical emergency. This page does not call. It waits for you to dial. Stay. Do not decide a whole life in this hour.
The bottom is not your name

You may be tired in a way a pretty word does not reach. Everything weighs. The future looks like a corridor with no door. The people around seem to live in a house you cannot enter. That hurts, and the pain is real. What is not real is the conclusion the pain wants to write in your place: that it is over, that you are the mistake, that the world is better without you. That is the voice of the pit. It is not the measure of your life. You are still here. While a body is reading this, the story has not closed. The bottom is a place. It is not an identity.
How the mind works against you

The mind is not a judge. It is a predictor. It takes what already hurt and projects the same film forward, because repeating costs less than doubting. At the bottom of the pit, attention narrows. You stop seeing the window, the hand, the plate, the person. Not because the good left the world. Because the sad state only delivers proof of the sad. This has a name: the mind confirms the mood it is already in. A repeated thought becomes a groove. The groove feels like truth only because you walked it a thousand times. It is not prophecy. It is a worn path. Sabotage starts when you obey the groove as if it were a fact. “It is not worth it.” “It does not change.” “I am a burden.” Those are old sentences. They are not measurements.
What a feeling is, and what it is not

A feeling is the body. Heart, sleep, hunger, the weight on the shoulders, the wish to disappear. It votes. It does not govern. Fear, shame, emptiness, and anger at yourself are signs that something is tight. They are not a permit to destroy yourself. Low frequency, in the sense that matters here, is not a punishment from the universe. It is attention stuck on what hurts. The more you contemplate the end, the more the nervous system rehearses the end, and the more the world shows up only as proof. It is not magic. It is rehearsal. That is why the work is not a fake smile. It is refusing to live the whole day inside the imagined danger. One small true relief — water, light on the face, someone’s name, a five-minute task finished — is not decoration. It is another station. The mind only finds what you point at. For one minute, point at one thing that is not the pit.

You are not in this dimension to be crushed by your own thought. You are here to evolve. To evolve, today, is not to become another person by tomorrow. It is to grow one degree: not to obey the sentence that asks for your destruction. Purpose does not need to be a speech. It can be small and still true. Someone is poorer if you leave. Sometimes that someone is you a year from now, who has not yet been given permission to exist. Action — what some traditions call kriya, the act — cuts the loop. Thinking the pit deepens the pit. One clean act opens a finger’s width of a way out. Drink water. Eat something real. Open the window. Send one sentence to one person: “I am not well, stay with me a little.” Lifting your head is not denying the pain. It is refusing to let the pain be the only chair.
The next hour, not the whole life

Do not solve the meaning of existence at three in the morning, hungry and without sleep. The tired brain lies with more certainty. The rule is this: no irreversible decision in the worst hour. The next hour has five acts, and one is enough. Water. Simple food. Daylight on the face, or a lamp if it is night. A wash, if the body allows. One sentence to a human, not to a group and not to the void. If the thought comes back — and it does — you do not argue with it as if it were an oracle. You say, inside: “this is the groove, not the fact”, and you do the next act. Depression is also a health matter. A doctor, sleep, food, someone who listens. A page does not replace that. A page keeps you from staying alone with the sentence that asks for the end.

Lift your head. Not to pretend it is light. To remember that the gaze chooses what comes in. A lowered head only sees the floor the belief already painted. A lifted head sees there is still a room, a sky, a next hour. You are not the destructive thought. You are the one who can notice the thought and not marry it. The pit lies when it says this is the end of the journey. It is a stretch. A stretch is crossed with one act, one person, and, if the pain went past what you can hold, with 188. You are here to grow. Start with what is still alive. You.
